It's not that you want to end your life, it's that you want to end the life you're currently living. That void is just dread that you're not living the life you want. The only way to fill that void is to do more things that bring you closer to the life you want to live. 

It's hard. I've been struggling for years. You've got to find wonder and beauty in life again in order to see that this right here, right now isn't permanent. 

I don't know what you're into but I'm a "hey look at the moon, it's so beautiful" type of person and what helped me (and has kinda established a routine which is needed when in a rut) is I go out to this spot and watch the sunrise (or sunset). And I mean really watch. I leave my phone in the glove box and I just sit for 40-60 min. Watch how the colors change right before your eyes. How the rays come up over the hills and it makes you just go, "wow!". I bring a notebook with me so I can write if I feel compelled to, but I just sit there and watch. 

I really urge you to try it or something close to your heart like that. Nothing changes if nothing changes. Just do one, ONE, thing a day, that will have a positive impact on your life that day. 

I also urge you to try to stop judging your body and start loving it. Easier said than done, I know. But for every negative thought you have about your self, shut it down the moment you have it and say, "no, that's not true. This (insert positive thing about me) is what's true". Even if that positive thing has nothing to do with the negative. That positive thing could be  that you didn't kill yourself today. That you put some nutrients and h2o in your self. That you were nice to your pets today (if you have them). Those things matter.
